label: def:briggs-klein-chart
title: Briggs--Klein affine chart
html: Let r=\lvert w_1\rvert^2 denote the squared modulus of the first resolvent coordinate on Bring's surface (Bring's surface). The Briggs--Klein affine chart is the coordinate system (w_1,w_2) restricted to the open set 0<r<\infty. It carries the Hermitian metric inherited from the Fubini--Study metric on \mathbb{P}^4. In this chart, the C_5 action acts as the phase rotation w_k\mapsto\zeta^kw_k, rendering the radial coordinate r invariant under C_5.
